title: Continuous change workflow
intent: Keep specifications and verification evidence synchronized after initial delivery.

contract.outcome: The continuous change is delivered with current specifications.

acceptance.criterion: The accepted change is verifiable through its public seam.

classification.rationale: The change spans the standard specification and delivery path.

research_disposition.rationale: The accepted change contract is already evidenced.

title: Restore the production path
intent: Diagnose and restore the failed production path while preserving reconciliation evidence.

contract.outcome: The failed production path is restored and regression verified.

acceptance.criterion: The failed path passes its deterministic regression check.

recovery.strategy: Restore the prior deploy and replay durable state.

classification.rationale: An active production failure requires the incident profile.

research_disposition.rationale: Incident diagnosis, not product research, is required.

baseline_bypass.reason: The baseline migration cannot precede the production recovery.
